description: In-Use Imported ACM Certificate Requires Renewal Review Within 90 Days
rationale: An imported certificate attached to an AWS resource expires within 90 days (or is already expired). AWS Certificate Manager does not automatically renew imported certificates. This is a manual renewal review signal, not proof that a renewal process is missing.
remediation: Confirm ownership and the external renewal calendar, obtain and import the replacement certificate, associate it with listeners before expiry, and verify production hostname/SAN coverage. Record the renewal evidence.
